resources.string: SlowGram collects no personal data: no analytics, no Firebase, no trackers, no mandatory server — everything runs locally on your device. The only permission is INTERNET, and your Instagram session stays in the app\'s local cookies (never sent to SlowGram). Cloud backup is disabled.

SlowGram is a free, open-source experiment that gently slows down compulsive Reels consumption. It runs Instagram Web inside a WebView and applies gradual, reversible degradation to the feed after a few minutes of continuous watching.
Reduce excessive, compulsive scrolling without blocking or guilt. The slowdown is imperceptible at first, escalates slowly, and fully reverts when you leave Reels.
SlowGram is MIT-licensed. No analytics, no trackers, no servers, no third-party SDKs. Read and audit everything on GitHub.
SlowGram is not affiliated with, associated with, authorized by, or sponsored by Meta Platforms, Inc. or Instagram. Instagram is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.
